newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: GETRONICS SEES CONTINUED STRONG GROWTH.
newsitem.headline: GETRONICS SEES CONTINUED STRONG GROWTH.

text.p: Electronics firm Getronics NV said on Thursday it was maintaining its forecast for strong growth in profits and turnover in the second half of 1997.

"Based on the increased growth of markets important to Getronics, the prospects for the second half year are judged positive. The previous forecast of continued strong growth of profits and turnover is maintained," the company said.

Earlier Getronics reported first-half 1997 net profits up 45 percent to 79 million guilders. Turnover grew 19 percent to 1.28 billion guilders and operating profits increased 18 percent to 107.8 million guilders.
Getronics said the sharp profit rise was partly the result of good business conditions at its RAET software unit.
In December it raised its stake in RAET to 100 percent from 50 percent, which it said had had a positive effect on profits in the first half.
Net margin increased to 6.2 percent compared to 5.1 percent in the first half of 1996, Getronics said.
